feedback: The confession follows my strongest pre-vote inference: Vincent's wooden-model defense was incompatible with the physical bottle evidence, and his preview attendance plus visit to the glass already supplied the route. It introduces the actual taking and pouring as confession rather than a new evidentiary rescue. The emotional turn to Dada connects his artistic dependency to the earlier exchanges, which makes it more affecting than a bare solution lecture. Chip and Elle's admissions appropriately resolve their separate lies without pretending they were innocent of everything. The ending feels earned as an explanation of the most suspicious defense, although the confession supplies certainty that the circumstantial pre-vote material could not. I would still want one discriminating observation to make the accusation feel deductively compelled.
